retrospective.harder_than_needed: S3's stories.json file list names only profileHandler.ts, registerHandlers.ts, and the test — but a real (non-optional) send capability for a background dispatcher handler can only be wired at MarmotContext.tsx's buildDispatcher call site, the same composition root that already supplies the precedented sendSelfProfile closure (mlsGroup/signer/pubkeyHex are only in scope there, per-group, inside the subscription loop). Threading the capability 'through the registration seam' (architecture.md's own phrasing) necessarily terminates one hop further out than the story's literal file list implies. This is a recurring shape for any handler-injection producer story in this codebase (profileRequestHandler's sendSelfProfile/handleIncomingProfileRequest already required the identical extra hop), so story file-lists for this DI pattern should either enumerate the composition-root call site or explicitly carve it out, rather than leaving the architect to infer it mid-implementation.
